papers.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract Waypoint-OPD improves policy-shift distillation by gating endpoint shifts using directional agreement between early and late teacher policy changes, boosting reasoning performance with minimal overhead.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.

ru.title: Сверяем курс учителя по промежуточным точкам, чтобы учить студента точнее
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод Waypoint-OPD для дистилляции политики, который улучшает перенос знаний от учителя к ученику (student LLM). Обычно используется только разница логарифмов вероятностей учителя до и после RL, но эта итоговая разница не показывает, была ли динамика предпочтений согласованной. Авторы сравнивают ранний и поздний промежуточные чекпоинты учителя и подавляют сдвиг, если их направления противоположны. Метод требует лишь один дополнительный проход учителя без обучения и показывает лучшие результаты в математических и кодовых задачах на моделях Qwen3.

en.title: Guiding Student Learning with Teacher Agreement
en.desc: Waypoint-OPD is a method that enhances policy-shift distillation by focusing on the agreement between early and late changes in a teacher's policy during reinforcement learning. It uses the differences in log probabilities from the teacher's training to guide the learning of student models, ensuring that only consistent shifts are transferred. By gating the endpoint shifts based on whether early and late shifts agree or oppose each other, it minimizes confusion and improves reasoning performance. This approach requires minimal additional computation while outperforming traditional methods in various reasoning tasks.

zh.title: 利用方向一致性提升策略迁移效果
zh.desc: Waypoint-OPD是一种改进的策略迁移蒸馏方法，通过比较教师策略在训练早期和晚期的变化方向来优化学生模型的学习效果。该方法利用教师在强化学习前后的日志概率差异，作为学生生成轨迹的监督信号。通过对早期和晚期策略变化的方向一致性进行评估，Waypoint-OPD能够选择性地转移知识，从而提高推理性能。实验结果表明，该方法在多个领域的学生模型中表现优异，验证了方向一致性在学生训练中的重要性。

papers.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract OmniCompass is a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding that evaluates vision-language and audio-visual reasoning through temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering tasks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

ru.title: Видеть и слышать вместе: OmniCompass проверяет, насколько мультимодальные LLM действительно понимают видео
ru.desc: В статье представлен OmniCompass — комплексный бенчмарк для оценки понимания видео и привязки (grounding) в омни-модальном формате, охватывающий vision-language и audio-visual задачи. Бенчмарк включает три типа задач: временную привязку (temporal grounding), пространственную привязку (spatial grounding) и question answering (QA) по видео разной длительности. Оценивается 50 MLLM, и результаты показывают, что open-source модели заметно отстают от проприетарных, особенно в аудиовизуальном понимании. Даже ведущие модели всё ещё плохо справляются с точной временной и пространственной локализацией и дают несогласованные предсказания при разных способах задания целевого объекта.

en.title: OmniCompass: A New Standard for Evaluating Video Understanding
en.desc: OmniCompass is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate omni-modal video grounding and understanding, focusing on both vision-language and audio-visual reasoning. It features two main evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL for vision-language models and OmniCompass-AV for omni-modal models, each addressing tasks like temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering. The benchmark includes a diverse set of videos and instances, ensuring thorough assessment across different durations and modalities. Results indicate that while multimodal large language models are advancing, they still struggle with precise grounding and consistency in predictions, especially in audio-visual contexts.

zh.title: OmniCompass：全模态视频理解的新基准
zh.desc: OmniCompass是一个全面的基准，用于评估全模态视频的定位和理解能力，涵盖视觉语言和音频视觉推理。它定义了两个评估轨道：OmniCompass-VL专注于视觉证据的任务，而OmniCompass-AV则关注需要联合音频视觉证据的任务。每个轨道包括三个互补任务：时间定位、空间定位和问答，分别评估目标出现的时间、位置和事件内容。评估结果显示，开源模型在音频视觉理解方面仍落后于专有模型，且在时间和空间定位上仍面临挑战。

papers.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
papers.abstract: Abstract MJev-Spatial is a fast multimodal decision model that unifies spatial reasoning tasks into a single-pass classification framework, improving speed and accuracy over autoregressive vision-language models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.

ru.title: Быстрое пространственное мышление без генерации текста
ru.desc: В статье представлена MJev-Spatial — быстрая мультимодальная модель принятия решений, которая решает задачи пространственного понимания через единую схему классификации, а не через авторегрессивную генерацию текста. Каждый вариант ответа рассматривается как класс и оценивается с помощью предобученных query- и key-проекций базовой VLM без добавления параметров, а числовые значения и точки предсказываются методом грубо-к-точному уточнения. Обучение на 12,3 млн пар вопрос-ответ, построенных из существующих датасетов, ускорено за счёт совместной супервизии и балансировки батчей по длине и нагрузке GPU. Модель на базе Qwen3.5-4B получает лучший общий результат среди восьми моделей и работает в 2,5 раза быстрее самой быстрой авторегрессивной базовой линии.

en.title: Speed and Accuracy in Spatial Reasoning with MJev-Spatial
en.desc: MJev-Spatial is a novel multimodal decision model designed to enhance spatial reasoning tasks by integrating them into a single-pass classification framework. Unlike traditional vision-language models that rely on autoregressive decoding, MJev-Spatial efficiently classifies spatial relations, distances, and placements without generating answer tokens. It utilizes a unified approach where each candidate option is treated as a class, leveraging pretrained query and key projections for scoring. This model not only improves inference speed but also achieves superior accuracy, outperforming existing models on multiple benchmarks while significantly increasing training efficiency.

zh.title: MJev-Spatial：快速高效的空间推理决策模型
zh.desc: MJev-Spatial是一种快速的多模态决策模型，能够将空间推理任务统一到一个单次分类框架中，从而提高速度和准确性。该模型通过将每个候选项视为一个类别，并利用预训练的查询和关键投影进行评分，避免了增加参数的复杂性。MJev-Spatial在推理时只需一次前向传播，不生成答案标记，显著提高了效率。经过训练后，该模型在多个基准测试中表现优异，速度比传统的自回归模型快2.5倍，准确率也达到了最高分。

papers.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
papers.abstract: Abstract OpenGCUA introduces an open generalist computer-use agent that integrates visual and programmatic interfaces, harness-to-model decision transfer, and code execution to improve task performance and efficiency across models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.

ru.title: Открытый агент, который думает кодом и сам решает, что смотреть
ru.desc: В статье представлен OpenGCUA — открытый обобщённый агент для работы с компьютером, который сочетает визуальные и программные интерфейсы и использует генерацию и выполнение кода. Ключевая идея — перенос решений о наблюдениях и состоянии задачи из жёстких правил харнесса в саму LLM (harness-to-model decision transfer). На бенчмарке OSWorld-v2 полная конфигурация повышает средний частичный балл на 19,6 пункта и сокращает число шагов на 53% по сравнению с пакетным GUI-only режимом. Авторы публикуют код, промпты, траектории восьми моделей и прототипы харнесса для реальных устройств и кросс-платформенного SDK.

en.title: Empowering Computers with Open Generalist Agents
en.desc: OpenGCUA is a project that develops a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) capable of performing tasks using both visual and programmatic interfaces. This agent improves efficiency by allowing models to execute code and make decisions based on intermediate results, enhancing their interaction with users' computers. The project aims to open up the design of GCUAs for community collaboration, addressing limitations found in existing closed systems like GPT-6 Astra. Initial results show significant improvements in task performance and efficiency across multiple models, demonstrating the potential of this approach in real-device environments.

zh.title: 开放通用计算机使用代理，提升任务效率
zh.desc: OpenGCUA是一个开放的通用计算机使用代理，旨在通过视觉和编程接口的整合来提高任务性能和效率。该系统允许模型选择如何观察、行动和组织工作，支持代码执行以便中间结果影响后续操作。我们提出的决策转移方法使得模型能够从固定规则中获取观察和任务状态决策，从而增强灵活性。通过在OSWorld-v2上的测试，OpenGCUA显著提高了多个模型的任务得分，并减少了每个任务的步骤。

papers.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
papers.abstract: Abstract FDE-Gym evaluates AI agents on realistic customer delivery tasks requiring clarification of ambiguous requirements and discovery of unstated constraints, revealing a substantial performance gap compared to well-specified benchmarks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

Exploration and Development Research Institute, PetroChina Southwest Oil & Gasfield Company
Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

ru.title: От идеальных задач к реальным заказчикам: AI-агентам ещё далеко до доставки результата
ru.desc: Статья представляет FDE-Gym — бенчмарк из 95 задач по доставке решений заказчикам, где AI-агенты должны уточнять неоднозначные требования и выявлять скрытые ограничения. Агенты работают в симулированной среде с имитацией стейкхолдеров и модифицируемыми системами, а оценка учитывает реальный бизнес-эффект и штрафы за лишние взаимодействия. Тестирование 13 конфигураций моделей показало, что лучший результат — средний балл 0.56 и решение лишь 14 из 95 задач, причём главный барьер — обнаружение неявных ограничений. Даже при получении всех ключевых фактов модели редко достигают высокой бизнес-ценности, что выявляет значительный разрыв между решением хорошо специфицированных задач и созданием эффективных LLM-систем для реальных клиентов.

en.title: Bridging the Gap: AI in Real-World Customer Delivery
en.desc: The paper introduces FDE-Gym, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on realistic customer delivery tasks that involve ambiguous requirements and hidden constraints. Unlike traditional benchmarks that focus on well-defined tasks, FDE-Gym presents 95 end-to-end delivery scenarios across various sectors, requiring agents to interact with stakeholders and adapt to dynamic environments. The evaluation metric measures how much the AI improves the customer's success metric, highlighting the challenges of discovering unstated constraints. Results show a significant performance gap, indicating that AI systems struggle to deliver effective solutions in real-world situations compared to controlled environments.

zh.title: FDE-Gym：揭示AI交付任务中的性能差距
zh.desc: FDE-Gym是一个评估人工智能代理在现实客户交付任务中的表现的基准。这些任务需要代理澄清模糊的需求并发现未说明的约束条件。与传统的基准测试不同，FDE-Gym模拟了真实的客户环境，代理需要与利益相关者互动并在生产系统上工作。研究表明，发现未说明的约束是主要瓶颈，导致代理在解决实际问题时表现不佳。

papers.title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
papers.abstract: Abstract Vision-language models struggle to convert 2D visual observations into precise 3D rotational control, showing large gaps versus humans in projection alignment tasks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.

ru.title: От 2D-картинки к точному 3D-управлению: VLM пока далеки от человека
ru.desc: Статья представляет RoTA-Bench — бенчмарк для оценки того, насколько vision-language модели (VLM) способны переводить 2D-наблюдения в точное 3D-управление вращением объектов. Задача состоит в том, чтобы по целевому силуэту подобрать последовательность поворотов 3D-объекта, восстанавливающих нужную проекцию в рамках ограниченного бюджета действий. Авторы строят 674 решаемых задачи из 2D-иконок, используя автоматический пайплайн с обратимой инициализацией, и выделяют тестовый набор из 100 задач. Эксперименты показывают большой разрыв между моделью (GPT-5.6-Sol решает 17% задач) и людьми (100%), а также расхождение между прогрессом по перекрытию силуэтов и по качеству выравнивания позы.

en.title: Bridging the Gap: From 2D Vision to 3D Precision
en.desc: This paper discusses the limitations of vision-language models in translating 2D visual inputs into accurate 3D rotational movements. The authors introduce RoTA-Bench, a benchmark designed to assess how well these models can align 3D objects with 2D projections through a series of rotations. Their experiments reveal a significant performance gap between human participants and the model, with humans achieving a 100% success rate compared to only 17% for the model. Additionally, the study shows that the model's ability to refine its actions based on visual feedback is heavily influenced by its interaction history, indicating that fine control in 3D tasks is a complex challenge.

zh.title: 视觉语言模型的三维控制挑战
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了视觉语言模型在将二维视觉观察转换为精确的三维旋转控制方面的困难。研究表明，模型在投影对齐任务中与人类存在显著差距，尤其是在推断物体几何形状和旋转效果方面。我们引入了RoTA-Bench来评估模型在交互式3D到2D投影对齐中的能力，并构建了674个任务以进行测试。实验结果显示，模型在任务成功率上远低于人类，且在细粒度控制方面对交互历史非常敏感。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
papers.abstract: Abstract A framework for self-evolving agent harnesses uses feedback-driven revisions and evolutionary optimization with theoretical generalization guarantees while keeping model weights fixed.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Агент учится совершенствовать собственную оболочку, а не веса модели
ru.desc: Статья описывает фреймворк самоэволюционирующих агентных обвязок (agent harness), в котором эффективность агента улучшается за счёт правки его программной оболочки: промптов, памяти, рабочих процессов и исполняемого кода, при неизменных весах LLM. Изменения принимаются по обратной связи и сохраняются между запусками, а поиск улучшений организован как эволюционная оптимизация. Теоретический анализ на основе continual PAC-learning даёт оценки обобщения, ограничения на деградацию ранее освоенных задач и правило принятия изменений на независимой валидационной выборке. Авторы также обсуждают риски для научной надёжности, безопасности и подотчётности, и подчёркивают необходимость непрерывной валидации и независимых защитных механизмов.

en.title: Empowering Agents with Self-Evolution and Feedback
en.desc: This paper presents a framework for self-evolving agents that utilize feedback-driven revisions and evolutionary optimization while keeping the model weights unchanged. The framework allows for the modification of an agent's software components, such as prompts and workflows, based on feedback, ensuring that successful changes are retained across different runs. It introduces a structured approach to differentiate between updates to the agent's state and revisions to its underlying tools and code. The authors also provide theoretical guarantees on the generalization and reliability of the framework through continual PAC-learning, emphasizing the importance of ongoing validation in dynamic environments.

zh.title: 自我进化代理：反馈驱动与进化优化的结合
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种自我进化代理的框架，该框架利用反馈驱动的修订和进化优化，同时保持模型权重不变。该框架允许代理的软件结构进行修订，包括提示、记忆、工作流程和可执行组件。我们形式化了一个反馈驱动的过程，使得接受的修订在多次运行中得以保留，并且区分了对解释状态的变化与对工具和代码的修订。通过进化优化的搜索，我们分析了其可靠性，并提供了期望的泛化界限和高概率的接纳规则。

papers.title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
papers.abstract: Abstract MAI-Gym is an open platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online reinforcement learning training across mobile, computer, and web environments, enabling scalable synthesis of verified tasks and training of a unified 9B agent with state-of-the-art open performance.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances. Beyond scalable infrastructure, MAI-Gym enables automated synthesis of diverse GUI applications and challenging tasks, including resettable mocked apps and coherent cross-app worlds with execution-validated task verifiers. Using MAI-Gym, we train MAI-Gym-9B, a unified 9B agent for mobile and computer use, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open GUI agents under 10B parameters: 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified. Importantly, RL in a mocked train-ticketing app transfers to its real-world counterpart, improving task success on a phys- ical phone from 28.8% to 48.1%. We release the framework, synthesis skills, mocked apps, 2,000 verified tasks, and the model checkpoint to support repro- ducible research and further advances in scalable GUI agent training.

ru.title: Обучаем GUI-агентов в симуляции — и они работают в реальном мире
ru.desc: Статья представляет MAI-Gym — открытую платформу, которая объединяет оценку GUI-агентов, сбор данных и онлайн-обучение с подкреплением (online RL) для мобильных, десктопных и веб-сред. Платформа масштабируется до 20 000 параллельных экземпляров окружения и автоматически генерирует разнообразные приложения и верифицируемые задачи, включая mock-приложения с проверкой выполнения. На её основе авторы обучили агента MAI-Gym-9B, который достигает лучших результатов среди открытых GUI-агентов до 10 млрд параметров на MobileWorld и OSWorld-Verified. Важно, что обучение в имитируемом приложении для покупки билетов переносится на реальное приложение, повышая успешность на физическом телефоне с 28.8% до 48.1%.

en.title: MAI-Gym: Unifying GUI Agent Training for Scalable Success
en.desc: MAI-Gym is a comprehensive platform designed for evaluating and training GUI agents using online reinforcement learning (RL) across various environments like mobile and web. It addresses the challenges of high costs and limited realistic tasks in training GUI agents by providing a unified framework that supports extensive data collection and consistent agent behavior. The platform allows for the automated creation of diverse GUI applications and complex tasks, enhancing the scalability of training with up to 20,000 parallel environments. Notably, the MAI-Gym-9B agent demonstrates impressive performance improvements in real-world applications, showcasing the effectiveness of this innovative approach to RL.

zh.title: MAI-Gym：统一的GUI代理训练平台
zh.desc: MAI-Gym是一个开放平台，统一了图形用户界面（GUI）代理的评估、数据收集和在线强化学习训练，适用于移动、计算机和网络环境。该平台通过共享的执行管道，确保代理在评估和训练中的一致行为，并支持十个已建立的基准测试，能够扩展到20,000个并行环境实例。MAI-Gym还能够自动合成多样化的GUI应用程序和具有挑战性的任务，包括可重置的模拟应用和具有执行验证的跨应用世界。使用MAI-Gym，我们训练了一个统一的9B代理，达到了在开放GUI代理中领先的性能，显著提高了在真实环境中的任务成功率。

papers.title: Learning Where to Split: Dynamic Band Splitting for Audio Source Separation
papers.abstract: Abstract Dynamic Band Splitting adapts frequency partition boundaries to each audio mixture, improving source separation quality while maintaining a fixed token budget.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Audio source separation models must preserve fine spectral structure while keeping the cost of the separator tractable. Band-split architectures reduce this cost by manually partitioning the spectrum into predefined frequency bands and encoding each band as a token, but the same boundaries are used for every mixture. Because informative spectral structure varies with source content, fixed boundaries can merge discriminative components or spend tokens where little resolution is needed. We introduce Dynamic Band Splitting (DBS), an end-to-end framework that adapts boundary locations and band widths to each mixture under a fixed band-token budget. DBS predicts content-conditioned boundary scores within frequency blocks, selects a prescribed number of boundaries using hard Top-K, and applies content-dependent pooling to obtain compact band tokens. After separation, it smooths and expands these tokens to the original STFT grid, refines them along frequency, and decodes complex masks with a frequency-shared head. DBS improved separation over the corresponding static models on DnR v2, MUSDB18-HQ, and EchoSet, with DBS-BSRNN achieving relative gain of 29.0% in average SI-SDR on DnR v2. These results and boundary analyses on DnR v2 show that content-adaptive frequency partitioning benefits multiple separator backbones under a fixed band-token budget. Code and audio demos are available at https://cslikai.cn/Dynamic-Band-Splitting

ru.title: Адаптивные частотные полосы: делим спектр по содержимому звука, а не по шаблону
ru.desc: Модели разделения аудио (source separation) должны сохранять тонкую спектральную структуру, но при этом оставаться вычислительно эффективными. Классические band-split архитектуры используют фиксированные границы частотных полос для всех смесей, что может объединять различительные компоненты или тратить ресурсы впустую. Авторы предлагают Dynamic Band Splitting (DBS): end-to-end метод, который предсказывает границы полос под содержимое каждой смеси с помощью Top-K отбора при фиксированном бюджете токенов. После разделения токены расширяются обратно на сетку STFT и декодируются в комплексные маски, что повышает качество разделения, например, на +29% по SI-SDR для DBS-BSRNN на DnR v2.

en.title: Adaptive Frequency Boundaries for Better Audio Separation
en.desc: Dynamic Band Splitting (DBS) is a novel approach in audio source separation that customizes frequency boundaries for each audio mixture, enhancing the quality of separation while adhering to a fixed token budget. Traditional band-split architectures use static frequency bands, which can lead to inefficiencies by merging important spectral components or wasting tokens. DBS intelligently predicts and adjusts these boundaries based on the content of the audio, allowing for more effective encoding of spectral information. The framework has demonstrated significant improvements in separation performance across various datasets, showcasing the advantages of adaptive frequency partitioning in machine learning models for audio processing.

zh.title: 动态频带分割：音频源分离的新突破
zh.desc: 动态频带分割（DBS）是一种音频源分离的新框架，它根据每个音频混合物自适应调整频率分割边界，从而提高源分离的质量，同时保持固定的令牌预算。传统的频带架构使用预定义的频率带进行分割，但这些固定的边界可能会导致信息丢失或资源浪费。DBS通过预测内容相关的边界分数，选择合适数量的边界，并进行内容依赖的池化，生成紧凑的频带令牌。实验结果表明，DBS在多个数据集上相较于静态模型有显著的分离性能提升。

papers.title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
papers.abstract: Abstract InfiniSplat v2 improves feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction by decoupling geometry and attribute prediction, aligning Gaussians with ground-truth poses, and using large-angle supervision to enhance novel-view rendering quality.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

ru.title: Чёткие 3D-сцены под любым углом: разделяй геометрию и атрибуты, и качество взлетит
ru.desc: В статье представлен InfiniSplat v2 — улучшенный метод feed-forward реконструкции 3D-сцен на основе 3D Gaussian Splatting, который строит сцену напрямую из входных изображений для рендеринга новых ракурсов. Авторы разделяют предсказание геометрии и атрибутов Гауссиан, замораживая геометрическую ветвь и выравнивая предсказанные Гауссианы по ground-truth позам камер во время обучения. Дополнительно используется supervision на целевых видах с большими углами поворота, что улучшает качество рендеринга при сильных изменениях точки обзора. На шести датасетах метод достигает state-of-the-art результатов по метрикам LPIPS и DISTS как в режиме с известными позами, так и без них.

en.title: Decoupling Geometry and Attributes for Superior 3D Rendering
en.desc: InfiniSplat v2 enhances the process of creating 3D scenes from images by separating the prediction of geometry and attributes. This method aligns the generated Gaussian representations with actual camera positions to improve accuracy. It also incorporates supervision for large-angle views to boost the quality of rendering from new perspectives. The results show significant improvements in rendering metrics, outperforming previous methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free scenarios.

zh.title: 解耦几何与属性，提升3D重建质量
zh.desc: InfiniSplat v2 是一种改进的前馈 3D 高斯重建方法，通过解耦几何和属性预测来提高渲染质量。该方法在训练过程中使用真实相机姿态对齐预测的高斯，并采用大角度监督来增强新视角渲染效果。我们分析了高斯属性学习的局限性，并通过架构和训练的改进来提升渲染质量。实验结果表明，在多个数据集上，InfiniSplat v2 在姿态条件和无姿态设置下均实现了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
papers.abstract: Abstract Sparse autoencoder features are partially compositional but require interaction terms for accurate behavioral predictions and steering.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively. We introduce SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), which measure the behavioral variation left unexplained above a chosen interaction order. Under independent feature subset sampling, population SAR is exactly the normalized energy of interactions above that order and bounds coalition ordering error for the optimal low order approximation. To distinguish compositionality associated with the SAE representation from that induced by downstream computation, we compare learned SAE coordinates with sum preserving random rotations of the same selected subspace and find lower first order residuals for the learned coordinates across all 18 model and behavior settings. The coordinates are nevertheless not fully additive: pairwise terms improve held out coalition ordering in every setting and outperform parameter matched models using randomly selected third order terms. In a combined steering experiment, pairwise modeling raises rank fidelity from 0.5874 to 0.7790 and reduces ordering error from 0.1444 to 0.0606. Together, these results show that SAE coordinates support comparatively compositional behavioral descriptions while faithful joint explanations and interventions still require interactions beyond individual feature effects. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/SAE-Behavioral-Compositionality.

ru.title: Признаки SAE почти аддитивны, но без взаимодействий не обойтись
ru.desc: Авторы исследуют, насколько признаки, выделенные разреженными автоэнкодерами (SAE) в активациях LLM, ведут себя аддитивно при их влиянии на поведение модели. Вводятся метрики SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), показывающие долю поведенческой вариации, не объяснимой взаимодействиями ниже заданного порядка. Сравнение с случайными поворотами подпространства показывает, что выученные координаты SAE заметно более компонуемы, чем произвольные. Однако парные и тройные взаимодействия всё же необходимы для точных предсказаний и управления моделью, что подтверждается экспериментами со steering.

en.title: Enhancing Sparse Autoencoders with Interaction Terms for Better Predictions
en.desc: This paper discusses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and their ability to represent features in a sparse manner, which can lead to behavioral predictions. However, the authors argue that these features alone are not enough for accurate predictions and that interaction terms are necessary. They introduce a new metric called SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR) to quantify the unexplained behavioral variation due to interactions. The findings suggest that while SAEs can provide useful representations, incorporating pairwise interactions significantly enhances prediction accuracy and reduces errors in behavioral modeling.

zh.title: 稀疏自编码器与行为预测的组合性
zh.desc: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在一定程度上是组合性的，但为了准确预测行为和引导，仍需考虑交互项。我们提出了SAE加性残差（SAR），用于衡量在选定交互阶数之上未解释的行为变异。通过独立特征子集采样，群体SAR正好是该阶数以上交互的归一化能量，并为最佳低阶近似的联盟排序误差提供界限。实验结果表明，虽然SAE坐标支持相对组合的行为描述，但忠实的联合解释和干预仍需超越单一特征效应的交互。

papers.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
papers.abstract: Abstract 3DCodeVerse is a research ecosystem that provides datasets, automated verification harnesses, and empirical guidance to enable scalable, editable, and verifiable 3D content generation via executable code.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.

ru.title: Проверяемые 3D-модели из кода, создаваемые AI-агентами
ru.desc: Статья представляет 3DCodeVerse — исследовательскую экосистему, которая помогает LLM-агентам создавать редактируемые и проверяемые 3D-объекты через исполняемый код. Авторы собрали датасет 3DCodeVerse-2M из более чем двух миллионов программ с ассетами и данными для верификации. Они также разработали мультиагентный фреймворк на основе DAG, который генерирует и улучшает 3D-контент, используя проверку выполнения, измерения геометрии и визуальную обратную связь без участия человека. Эксперименты показывают, что дообучение открытых моделей на этом датасете заметно улучшает их способности к 3D-кодингу, а их система выигрывает у Claude Design в 90% попарных сравнений с участием людей.

en.title: Empowering 3D Content Creation with Code and Automation
en.desc: 3DCodeVerse is a research ecosystem designed to facilitate the generation of 3D content through executable code. It includes a large dataset of 3D executable code, a coding harness for automated verification, and empirical guidance for developers. The system allows coding agents to create and refine 3D content efficiently, using spatial reasoning and visual feedback without needing human intervention. Experiments show that fine-tuning models on the 3DCodeVerse dataset significantly enhances their 3D coding abilities, achieving high performance in evaluations against existing systems.

zh.title: 3D内容生成的新生态系统
zh.desc: 3DCodeVerse是一个研究生态系统，旨在通过可执行代码实现可扩展、可编辑和可验证的3D内容生成。它包含大规模、高质量的可执行3D代码数据集，以及用于空间推理和自动验证的编码工具。我们构建了3DCodeVerse-2M数据集，收集开源数据并生成新的程序，以支持3D编码的研究。通过系统的实证研究，我们发现微调我们的数据集显著提升了开源模型的3D编码能力。

papers.title: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract SCOPE improves text-to-image prompt rewriting via reinforcement learning by aligning policy updates with semantic spans, boosting generation quality without extra rendering.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.

ru.title: Учим языковую модель переписывать промпты, опираясь на смысловые фрагменты
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод SCOPE, который улучшает переписывание промптов для text-to-image моделей с помощью обучения с подкреплением (RL). Вместо одного сигнала на каждый subword-токен, SCOPE группирует токены в семантические спаны (объекты, количества, атрибуты, отношения) и агрегирует сдвиги log-вероятностей политики внутри каждого спана. Метод основан на GRPO и не требует отдельных наград для спанов или дополнительных рендеров изображений. Эксперименты на Qwen-Image, SD3 и FLUX.1-dev показывают прирост над обычным GRPO в среднем на 9.48% на GeneVal и 7.62% на T2I-CompBench.

en.title: Enhancing T2I Prompts with Semantic Structure in RL
en.desc: The paper introduces SCOPE, a method that enhances text-to-image (T2I) prompt rewriting using reinforcement learning (RL). It focuses on aligning policy updates with semantic spans, which are coherent groups of related words, rather than treating each word individually. By employing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), SCOPE improves the quality of generated prompts without needing extra image rendering. The results show significant performance gains on various benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of leveraging semantic structures in RL for prompt engineering.

zh.title: 通过语义对齐提升文本到图像生成质量
zh.desc: SCOPE是一种通过强化学习改进文本到图像提示重写的方法。它通过将策略更新与语义跨度对齐，提升生成质量，而无需额外的渲染。与传统方法不同，SCOPE考虑了对象、数量、属性和关系等语义结构，优化了提示生成过程。实验结果表明，SCOPE在多个基准测试中显著提高了生成效果，验证了语义结构在强化学习提示工程中的有效性。

papers.title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract Speculative Forcing accelerates few-step autoregressive video generation by accepting early token drafts and skipping unnecessary denoising steps while preserving output quality.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing, a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator's intermediate features to estimate each token's remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ~1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5x faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ~2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35x faster at 24.5 fps.

ru.title: Не все токены нуждаются в полном денойзинге: быстрее видео без потери качества
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают метод Speculative Forcing, который ускоряет авторегрессионную генерацию видео с малым числом шагов денойзинга. Промежуточные оценки токенов рассматриваются как черновики, и токены, уже близкие к финальному результату, фиксируются досрочно и больше не проходят денойзинг, а их ключи и значения остаются в контексте. Для принятия решения исследованы два верификатора: безобученный, основанный на сходстве с чистым контентом и стабильности между шагами, и обучаемый, который по признакам замороженного генератора оценивает оставшийся разрыв до полного результата. На LongLive метод сохраняет качество четырёхшагового генератора при примерно 1,7 шагах на токен и ускоряется более чем в 1,5 раза, а на Lingbot-World 2.0 при 2,5 шагах на токен работает в 1,35 раза быстрее.

en.title: Accelerating Video Generation with Speculative Forcing
en.desc: This paper introduces Speculative Forcing, a method that speeds up video generation by allowing early acceptance of token drafts, which reduces unnecessary denoising steps. Traditional autoregressive video generators process every token through the final denoising step, even when some tokens are already close to their final form. Speculative Forcing identifies which tokens can be accepted early, freezing them to avoid further computation while still using their context for subsequent tokens. This approach maintains high output quality while significantly increasing generation speed across various video types.

zh.title: 推测性强制：加速视频生成的新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为“推测性强制”的框架，用于加速少步自回归视频生成。该方法通过接受早期的标记草稿并跳过不必要的去噪步骤，从而在保持输出质量的同时减少计算量。研究发现，许多标记在初始步骤中已经接近最终输出，因此不需要经过完整的去噪过程。推测性强制通过预测何时可以安全接受个别标记，优化了视频生成的效率。

papers.title: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
papers.abstract: Abstract MRTPO improves multi-reward training by assigning each reward's advantage only to relevant tokens via replay-based relevance measurement, accelerating convergence and boosting performance.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Language models are increasingly trained against several verifiable rewards at once, such as the correctness and the format of a tool call, or the individual constraints of a complex instruction. Reward-decoupled normalization (GDPO) normalizes each reward separately so that different reward combinations keep distinct advantages, but it still spreads every reward's advantage evenly over the whole response, although each verifier checks only a few positions. We propose MRTPO, which assigns the advantage of each reward to the tokens relevant to it, using the information its verifier checks, without auxiliary models or token-level annotations. For each reward, the policy replays its own response with and without that reward's verifier information, and the per-token Jensen-Shannon distance between the two next-token distributions measures each token's relevance and reassigns the advantage. On text-to-SQL, multi-constraint instruction following and tool calling, MRTPO converges faster and achieves better performance than the compared methods.

ru.title: Награда — только тем токенам, которые она проверяет
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод MRTPO для обучения LLM с несколькими верифицируемыми наградами одновременно. Вместо равномерного распределения advantage каждой награды по всему ответу, метод назначает её только релевантным токенам. Релевантность измеряется через replay: модель сравнивает распределения следующего токена с учётом и без информации верификатора, используя Jensen-Shannon distance. Эксперименты на text-to-SQL, следовании множественным ограничениям и tool calling показывают более быструю сходимость и лучшее качество по сравнению с GDPO и другими подходами.

en.title: Targeted Token Advantage for Faster Learning
en.desc: MRTPO is a method that enhances multi-reward training in machine learning by focusing on the relevant tokens for each reward. Instead of spreading the advantages of rewards evenly across all tokens, MRTPO uses a replay-based approach to measure the relevance of tokens based on the specific verifier information. This allows the model to assign advantages only to the tokens that are pertinent to each reward, improving the learning process. As a result, MRTPO shows faster convergence and better performance in tasks like text-to-SQL and complex instruction following compared to traditional methods.

zh.title: MRTPO：精准分配奖励优势，提升训练效率
zh.desc: MRTPO是一种改进多奖励训练的方法，它通过重放基础的相关性测量，将每个奖励的优势仅分配给相关的标记，从而加速收敛并提升性能。与传统的奖励解耦归一化方法不同，MRTPO能够根据验证者检查的信息，精确地将每个奖励的优势分配给相关的标记，而不需要辅助模型或标记级别的注释。该方法在文本到SQL、多约束指令跟随和工具调用等任务上表现出更快的收敛速度和更好的性能。通过对每个奖励的响应进行重放，MRTPO有效地测量每个标记的相关性，重新分配优势。

papers.title: VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract VLA-Δ improves robot control by explicitly supervising physical state transitions between current and future observations, achieving strong benchmark and real-world results without added inference cost.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-Δ, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-Δ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms π_{0.5} in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta

ru.title: Учим робота понимать, как меняется мир, а не только повторять действия
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают VLA-Δ — фреймворк для управления роботами, где vision-language-action модель явно обучается на физических изменениях состояния между текущим и будущим наблюдением, а не только сопоставлять наблюдения с действиями. Для этого собран крупномасштабный pretraining датасет с аннотациями переходов состояний, отражающими семантику задачи и визуальные движения. Во время инференса модель генерирует действия напрямую из текущих наблюдений, поэтому дополнительных вычислительных затрат нет. Метод показывает результаты, сопоставимые с state of the art на LIBERO и RoboTwin, и превосходит π_{0.5} в экспериментах на реальном роботе.

en.title: Supervising State Transitions for Better Robot Control
en.desc: VLA-Δ is a new framework that enhances robot control by focusing on the physical changes between current and future states during action generation. Unlike traditional models that simply map observations to actions, VLA-Δ explicitly supervises these state transitions, reducing the risk of overfitting. It utilizes a large-scale pretraining dataset with annotations for physical state changes, which helps the model learn more effectively. As a result, VLA-Δ achieves competitive performance on benchmark tests and in real-world applications without increasing inference costs.

zh.title: VLA-Δ：通过物理状态转变提升机器人控制
zh.desc: VLA-Δ是一种改进机器人控制的方法，通过明确监督当前和未来观察之间的物理状态转变来提升性能。该模型利用视觉-语言预训练中获得的语义知识，成功地将其转移到机器人控制任务中。与传统方法不同，VLA-Δ显式地监督物理状态的变化，从而减少了观察-动作对应关系的过拟合风险。实验结果表明，VLA-Δ在多个基准测试和真实机器人实验中表现优异，且没有增加推理成本。

papers.title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Multi-session agentic reinforcement learning is introduced to handle trajectories across multiple sessions, with Mosaic optimizing session-level contributions and allocation via hierarchical advantage estimation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.

ru.title: Оценивай вклад каждой сессии, а не всю траекторию целиком
ru.desc: Статья представляет многосессионное агентное обучение с подкреплением (Multi-Session Agentic RL), где траектория агента может охватывать несколько сессий, например при сжатии контекста или форкинге субагентов. Обычные методы broadcasting рассылают advantage траектории всем сессиям, не различая их вклад. Авторы предлагают метод Mosaic, который без critic использует иерархическую оптимизацию: на уровне траектории учитывает сигналы использования сессий, а на уровне сессии формирует advantage по оценке предельного вклада. Эксперименты на BrowseComp с Qwen3.5-4B показывают, что Mosaic превосходит broadcasting, используя в среднем меньше сессий.

en.title: Optimizing Multi-Session Learning with Mosaic
en.desc: This paper presents Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning (MSARL), which addresses the limitations of traditional reinforcement learning methods that typically focus on single-session trajectories. MSARL allows for the handling of trajectories that span multiple sessions, enabling more complex interactions and learning scenarios. The proposed method, Mosaic, optimizes session-level contributions and allocations using hierarchical advantage estimation, distinguishing the impact of each session. Experimental results demonstrate that Mosaic outperforms existing methods by improving session utility and requiring fewer sessions for effective learning.

zh.title: 多会话自主强化学习的新方法
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种多会话自主强化学习方法，旨在处理跨多个会话的轨迹。Mosaic通过分层优势估计优化会话级别的贡献和分配。与传统的单会话强化学习方法不同，该方法支持任意数量的会话，并在轨迹级别引入会话使用信号以改进优势估计。实验结果表明，Mosaic在上下文压缩和子代理分叉场景中表现优于传统的广播方法，同时平均使用的会话数量更少。

papers.title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract CommerceGen-Studio is a three-stage framework that generates commercial e-commerce product images by combining iterative metadata distillation, layout optimization, and a specialized diffusion model to maintain subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and text accuracy at production scale.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.

ru.title: Готовые к публикации товарные фото в промышленном масштабе с помощью AI
ru.desc: В статье представлен CommerceGen-Studio — трёхэтапный фреймворк для генерации главных изображений товаров для e-commerce. Сначала агент PERL-Agent с помощью VLM и LLM извлекает из метаданных SKU краткие списки преимуществ товара, оценивая их по reference-free рубрике в итеративном цикле. Затем модель SKU-DiT, обученная по схеме RDR, генерирует изображение с учётом фото товара, обрезки торговой марки и структуры макета, сохраняя точность текста и целостность бренда. Система работает в продакшене на миллионах изображений в день и на открытом бенчмарке CommerceGen-Bench превосходит open-source аналоги, сравнимые с закрытыми моделями.

en.title: Revolutionizing E-commerce Image Generation at Scale
en.desc: CommerceGen-Studio is a novel three-stage framework designed to generate high-quality e-commerce product images efficiently. It utilizes a Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) to distill product metadata into effective selling points, ensuring clarity and relevance. The Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) enhances the alignment between image captions and visual quality through targeted policy optimization. Finally, the SKU-DiT model maintains fidelity and accuracy in generated images, achieving impressive production capabilities with millions of images processed daily.

zh.title: 高效生成电商产品图像的三阶段框架
zh.desc: CommerceGen-Studio 是一个三阶段框架，旨在生成商业电子商务产品图像。该框架结合了迭代元数据提炼、布局优化和专门的扩散模型，以确保主题保真度、商标完整性和文本准确性。通过信息提取、语义重写和多条件生成的流程，CommerceGen-Studio 能够高效地处理大量产品图像。该系统每天可生成数百万张主图像，具有几秒钟的延迟，展示了其在商业规模上的应用潜力。

papers.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that uses multi-codebook discrete visual tokens to unify image, video, and 3D generation with text in a single backbone, achieving high performance and faster inference.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Unified multimodal generation covers discrete, continuous, and hybrid paradigms. Discrete approaches with single-codebook visual tokenizers align naturally with text modeling but have limited representational capacity. Continuous and hybrid approaches retain richer visual representations, but they model text and images in heterogeneous spaces with different training objectives, potentially introducing optimization conflicts between modalities with misaligned representation spaces. These choices expose a central question: how to efficiently model high-capacity visual representations alongside textual content in a shared optimization space within a single backbone. We present Intern Lumina U2, to our knowledge the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. Each visual position is represented by a group of codes from complementary codebooks, increasing its representational capacity while preserving compatibility with discrete text modeling. At the input, the embeddings are concatenated at each position; at the output, a lightweight multi-codebook autoregressive head predicts the codes within each position sequentially, while the diffusion backbone processes all positions in parallel. Built on the unified 4D representation of AToken, Intern Lumina U2 supports image, video, and 3D inputs within a single backbone and achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing. We further build a full-stack training, inference, and evaluation system on both Ascend and NVIDIA platforms to verify the cross-platform effectiveness of our model. We also improve the inference efficiency through a stability-aware sampling strategy, which combines confidence-plateau-guided unmasking approach with drift-triggered cache refreshing mechanisms, accelerating image generation by 4.45x.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Единая дискретная модель: текст, изображения, видео и 3D в одной архитектуре
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Intern Lumina U2 — диффузионную языковую модель, которая работает полностью в дискретном пространстве и использует мультикодбуковые визуальные токены для каждой позиции. Это повышает выразительность визуальных представлений и сохраняет совместимость с моделированием текста, а модель объединяет понимание и генерацию изображений, видео и 3D в одной архитектуре. Для вывода используется лёгкая мультикодбуковая авторегрессионная голова, а сама диффузионная основа обрабатывает все позиции параллельно. Благодаря стабильному сэмплированию с управляемым демаскированием и обновлением кэша генерация изображений ускоряется в 4,45 раза.

en.title: Unifying Visual and Textual Generation with Multi-Codebook Tokens
en.desc: Intern Lumina U2 is a novel diffusion language model that integrates multi-codebook discrete visual tokens to enhance the generation of images, videos, and 3D content alongside text. This model addresses the limitations of traditional discrete approaches by increasing representational capacity while maintaining compatibility with text modeling. By utilizing a unified optimization space, it effectively aligns high-capacity visual representations with textual content, minimizing conflicts between different modalities. Additionally, the model incorporates a stability-aware sampling strategy that significantly boosts inference efficiency, achieving faster image generation times.

zh.title: 统一多模态生成的高效模型
zh.desc: Intern Lumina U2 是一种扩散语言模型，使用多代码本离散视觉标记，将图像、视频和3D生成与文本统一在一个基础架构中，达到高性能和更快的推理速度。该模型通过思维机器的 Inkling-Small 实现了统一的多模态生成，涵盖离散、连续和混合范式。与单代码本视觉标记器的离散方法相比，Intern Lumina U2 提高了表示能力，同时保持与离散文本建模的兼容性。通过稳定感知采样策略，模型在图像生成方面的效率提高了4.45倍。

papers.title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Abstract AutoSFT uses multi-agent collaboration to automate diverse supervised fine-tuning data actions, improving evaluation scores over single-agent systems by separating execution, analysis, and synthesis.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce AutoSFT, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by +6.5, and synthesis adds +3.4 IFEval and +2.9 IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds +3.7 MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Автоматизация данных для SFT: сила в разнообразии действий, а не в одном сильном ходе
ru.desc: В статье представлена система AutoSFT, которая автоматизирует работу с данными для supervised fine-tuning (SFT) языковых моделей с помощью multi-agent подхода. Мета-агент разделяет выполнение, анализ и синтез, а субагенты предлагают разные варианты изменения датасета: пропорции категорий, фильтрацию, исправление и генерацию новых примеров. Такой подход дает прирост по бенчмаркам IFEval, IFBench и MBPP+, при этом модель и бюджет остаются фиксированными. Авторы делают вывод, что эффективность автоматизации SFT зависит от покрытия разнообразных действий с данными, а не от силы одного действия.

en.title: Automating Supervised Fine-Tuning with Multi-Agent Collaboration
en.desc: AutoSFT is a multi-agent system designed to enhance supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by automating various data actions through collaboration. Unlike traditional single-agent systems that focus on one type of data manipulation, AutoSFT separates execution, analysis, and synthesis tasks among different agents. This approach allows for a broader range of data adjustments, leading to improved evaluation scores, such as a +6.5 increase in IFEval. The study demonstrates that the effectiveness of automated SFT relies more on the diversity of data actions performed rather than the strength of a single action.

zh.title: 多智能体协作，提升监督微调效率
zh.desc: AutoSFT 是一种多智能体协作系统，旨在自动化多样化的监督微调数据操作。通过将执行、分析和合成分开，AutoSFT 提高了评估分数，相比于单一智能体系统更为有效。该系统设计了一种数据操作空间，使得自动化系统能够执行多种数据处理任务，而不仅仅是单一任务。研究结果表明，自动化监督微调数据研究更依赖于覆盖多样化的数据操作，而不是单一操作的强度。

papers.title: DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract DeltaStreamer is an agentic framework for streaming video understanding that uses change-aware memory and query-driven replay to preserve event dynamics and recover missing visual evidence for accurate answers.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. Existing approaches often obscure event transitions and omit relevant details when compressing video history, and cannot recover missing visual evidence. DeltaStreamer addresses these limitations by combining change-aware memory with query-driven planning and targeted evidence gathering with replay. Before a query arrives, it continuously observes the stream and explicitly records visual changes in structured memory, preserving how events unfold rather than only what is present. When a query arrives, a query-driven planner identifies the required evidence and guides memory retrieval and targeted replay. By revisiting historical frames, the agent can recover visual details omitted during observation and ground its answer in evidence beyond the retained descriptions. This connects continuous observation with active investigation tailored to each question. Experiments on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench demonstrate improvements over representative streaming video understanding methods, with overall scores of 66.07% and 59.53%, respectively.   Project page: https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/
affiliations: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Запоминать изменения, а не только кадры: видеопонимание в реальном времени
ru.desc: Статья представляет DeltaStreamer — агентную систему для понимания потокового видео, которая вдохновлена тем, как человек наблюдает, запоминает и исследует происходящее. Модель непрерывно фиксирует визуальные изменения в структурированной памяти, сохраняя динамику событий, а не только статичные объекты. Когда приходит запрос, планировщик на основе запроса определяет нужные доказательства и запускает целевой повторный просмотр (replay) исторических кадров. Эксперименты на OVO-Bench и StreamingBench показывают улучшение результатов по сравнению с существующими методами: 66.07% и 59.53% соответственно.

en.title: DeltaStreamer: Enhancing Video Understanding with Smart Memory and Replay
en.desc: DeltaStreamer is a new framework designed for understanding streaming video by mimicking human observation and memory. It uses a special memory system that focuses on changes in the video, allowing it to remember important details even before knowing what questions will be asked. When a question comes in, DeltaStreamer can quickly find and replay the relevant parts of the video to provide accurate answers. This approach improves the ability to track events and recover missing visual information, outperforming existing methods in tests.

zh.title: DeltaStreamer：流媒体视频理解的新框架
zh.desc: DeltaStreamer是一个用于流媒体视频理解的框架，它结合了变化感知记忆和查询驱动重放，以保持事件动态并恢复缺失的视觉证据。该系统在接收到查询之前，持续观察视频流并记录视觉变化，从而保留事件的展开过程。与传统方法相比，DeltaStreamer能够更好地处理事件过渡，并在查询到来时，通过查询驱动的规划来指导记忆检索和目标重放。实验结果表明，DeltaStreamer在流媒体视频理解任务中表现优于现有方法。

papers.title: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.abstract: Abstract OneWM unifies causal training of world and action modeling, showing that learning action-conditioned dynamics improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.

ru.title: Мир и действия учатся вместе: каждое делает другое умнее
ru.desc: В статье представлен OneWM — фреймворк, который объединяет обучение world model и action model в одной причинно-следственной (causal) архитектуре видео и действий. Действия используются одновременно как условие для предсказания будущих состояний мира и как цель для обучения policy. Эксперименты на LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus и RoboCasa365, а также на реальном роботе показывают, что обучение динамике, обусловленной действиями, улучшает качество и обобщаемость policy при изменении сцен. В свою очередь, обучение генерации действий повышает точность многовидового предсказания мира, то есть наблюдается взаимная польза.

en.title: OneWM: Unifying Action Learning and World Modeling for Better Policies
en.desc: The paper introduces OneWM, a framework that combines causal training for both world modeling and action learning. It demonstrates that when actions are used to condition the learning of dynamics, it enhances the performance of policies. Additionally, the study shows that improving action generation leads to better predictions of the world from multiple views. Overall, the findings highlight the mutual benefits of integrating action learning and world modeling in a unified approach.

zh.title: 统一因果训练：提升策略与世界建模的双向收益
zh.desc: OneWM是一个统一因果训练框架，结合了世界建模和动作建模。它表明，在特定动作条件下学习动态可以提高策略学习的效果，同时学习生成动作也能改善多视角世界预测的准确性。通过在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa365等测试平台上进行实验，结果显示，学习指定动作的视觉后果能够提升策略性能和在变化场景中的泛化能力。总的来说，这项研究证明了世界建模和动作生成之间的互惠关系。

papers.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
papers.abstract: Abstract Orbia introduces a benchmark that systematically evaluates 3D consistency in interactive video world models through controlled exploration, revisit protocols, and multi-dimensional measurements of input preservation, content persistence, and geometric self-consistency.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency.
