zh.desc: SCOPED是一种训练独立专家以实现不同能力的机器学习方法。它通过奖励引导反思提取技能，并将程序知识浓缩为统一的视觉-语言模型，从而减少跨能力干扰。在训练过程中，专家的技能指导监督，但在推理时对统一模型不可见，促使其内化程序知识。实验结果表明，SCOPED在多模态基准测试中表现优于传统方法，证明了技能解耦的有效性。

papers.title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract Representation Forcing improves few-step video generation by using feature-space supervision instead of trajectory regression, boosting quality metrics over causal ODE baselines.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.

ru.title: Учим быструю генерацию видео смотреть на признаки, а не на траектории
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод Representation Forcing для дистилляции предобученных video diffusion моделей в быстрые авторегрессивные (AR) генераторы видео с небольшим числом шагов сэмплирования. Вместо регрессии траекторий промежуточного учителя модель обучается через supervision в пространстве признаков: чистые предсказания студента сравниваются с целевыми признаками замороженного video diffusion transformer, что уменьшает размытие и сохраняет мелкие детали. Затем применяется асимметричная процедура Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), которая остаётся без изменений. На четырёх шагах сэмплирования метод улучшает VBench Total с 84.04 до 84.66 и VisionReward с 6.326 до 10.074 относительно базового causal ODE подхода.

en.title: Boosting Video Generation Quality with Representation Forcing
en.desc: This paper introduces Representation Forcing, a novel approach to enhance few-step video generation by utilizing feature-space supervision instead of relying solely on trajectory regression. The method improves the quality of generated videos by training a student model with clean predictions compared to targets derived from a frozen video diffusion transformer. By leveraging synthetic videos from a bidirectional model, the approach eliminates the need for additional causal ODE trajectories while maintaining effective teacher forcing. Empirical results demonstrate that Representation Forcing significantly boosts generation quality metrics compared to traditional methods, particularly in short sampling scenarios.

zh.title: 表示强制：提升视频生成质量的新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为表示强制（Representation Forcing）的方法，用于改善少步视频生成的质量。该方法通过特征空间监督来学习因果初始化，而不是依赖中间教师的轨迹回归。研究表明，直接的潜在回归虽然可以减少模糊，但仍无法解决细节问题。通过与冻结的视频扩散变换器的标准化特征进行比较，学生模型在训练中能够更好地保留生成质量。

papers.title: TimeRSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Abstract TimeRSI is an agentic system that iteratively improves forecasting pipelines via error-guided code revisions and adaptive selection, boosting zero-shot time-series performance without altering frozen models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real-world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and recurring forecast errors unaddressed, while tailored pipelines require substantial human expertise and effort. We introduce TimeRSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A coding agent translates task descriptions into executable pipeline changes. It tests each revision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent revisions. During deployment, an adaptive selector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar conditions. Across 198 tasks on TIME and fev-bench, TimeRSI outperforms all submissions on six point and probabilistic forecasting metrics. Controlled comparisons support the value of feedback-guided revision over non-iterative pipeline search. Further experiments verify the generalization with different coding agents and forecasting models. Code is available at https://github.com/haoxin1998/TimeRSI.

ru.title: Самоулучшающиеся агенты превращают zero-shot прогнозы в точные решения
ru.desc: В статье представлена TimeRSI — агентная система, которая итеративно улучшает пайплайны прогнозирования временных рядов вокруг замороженных foundation-моделей без их переобучения. Кодирующий AI-агент переводит описание задачи в исполняемые изменения пайплайна, тестирует их на исторических окнах прогноза и использует наблюдаемые ошибки для направления следующих правок. На этапе деплоя адаптивный селектор выбирает подходящий пайплайн, опираясь на завершённые прогнозы в похожих условиях. Эксперименты на 198 задачах из TIME и fev-bench показывают превосходство над всеми участниками по шести метрикам точечного и вероятностного прогнозирования.

en.title: Enhancing Forecasting with Adaptive, Error-Guided Revisions
en.desc: TimeRSI is a novel system designed to enhance forecasting pipelines by making iterative improvements based on errors observed during predictions. It utilizes frozen time-series foundation models, which are strong in zero-shot forecasting, but typically require specific adjustments for practical use. The system employs a coding agent that translates task descriptions into actionable changes in the forecasting pipeline, testing these changes against historical data to refine its approach. By adaptively selecting the best-performing pipelines based on past forecasts, TimeRSI demonstrates superior performance across various tasks, showcasing the effectiveness of feedback-guided revisions in machine learning applications.

zh.title: TimeRSI：自我改进的时间序列预测系统
zh.desc: TimeRSI 是一个自我改进的系统，能够通过错误引导的代码修订和自适应选择来逐步提升时间序列预测的性能，而无需改变冻结的模型。它通过将任务描述转化为可执行的管道更改，来优化预测流程。该系统在历史预测窗口上测试每个修订，并利用观察到的错误来指导后续的修订。在多个任务上，TimeRSI 在六个预测指标上超越了所有提交，证明了反馈引导修订的价值。

papers.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
papers.abstract: Abstract A new metric called semCER uses an LLM judge to weight grapheme edits by severity, improving alignment with human ratings over standard character error rate for OCR and vision-language models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.

ru.title: Опечатка не равна ошибке в имени: оценивать OCR нужно по серьезности правок
ru.desc: В статье предлагается новая метрика semCER для оценки OCR и vision-language моделей (VLM). Она сохраняет структуру классической Character Error Rate, но взвешивает каждую правку на уровне графем по степени серьезности, которую оценивает LLM-судья. Такой подход лучше совпадает с оценками живых читателей, чем стандартный CER, на английском, вьетнамском и китайском языках. Авторы также публикуют набор из 61 миллиона оцененных правок, агрегированные оценки людей и дистиллированный scorer.

en.title: semCER: A Smarter Way to Measure Character Errors
en.desc: The paper introduces a new metric called semCER, which enhances the evaluation of character errors in Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and vision-language models by incorporating severity ratings from a large language model (LLM). Unlike the traditional character error rate (CER), which treats all errors equally, semCER assigns different weights to grapheme edits based on their perceived severity, aligning more closely with human judgment. This metric maintains the structure of CER while providing a more nuanced breakdown of errors, allowing for better insights into transcription quality across multiple languages. The authors provide access to a dataset of 61 million judged edits and their corresponding severity ratings to facilitate further research and application.

zh.title: 引入semCER：更精准的字符错误评估
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的度量标准，称为semCER，它利用大型语言模型（LLM）来根据严重性对字符编辑进行加权，从而提高了与人类评分的一致性。传统的字符错误率（CER）对所有错误的惩罚相同，而semCER则根据每个字符编辑的严重性进行评分，保持了CER的结构。通过对16种语言的评估，semCER在英语和中文中更受读者认可，能够更准确地反映编辑的严重性。我们还发布了6100万条经过评估的编辑和聚合的读者评分，以供研究使用。

papers.title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract: Abstract Hidden states encode task information before the readout expresses it, so behavioral timelines reflect readout learning rather than model acquisition, and faster readout training closes this gap earlier.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which fits one sparse dictionary to every token's readout row at every checkpoint. Unlike crosscoders on activations, it needs only checkpoint weights. We use it to locate a narrow early window, 0.4-1.1% of the way through Pythia's pretraining, in which the readout reorganizes and WordNet word categories become decodable from its rows. By then, linear probes on the hidden states already decode task information that the model's own outputs do not yet show. To test whether such gaps depend on how fast the readout learns, we pretrain small models from scratch that differ only in the readout's learning rate. We find that raising it makes the readout develop earlier and the gap close sooner, with little effect on final loss. Together, these results imply that early in training, where many developmental transitions are dated, a behavioral date can reflect when the readout learns to express task information and not when the model learns it.

ru.title: Модель знает раньше, чем умеет это выразить
ru.desc: Авторы показывают, что скрытые состояния языковой модели содержат информацию о задаче раньше, чем её выходной слой (readout, unembedding-матрица) начинает её выражать, поэтому моменты «появления способности» по поведению модели могут отражать обучение readout, а не самой модели. Для прямого анализа readout предложен метод parameter-trajectory crosscoding: разреженный словарь обучается на строках readout по всем чекпоинтам, без использования активаций. На примере Pythia найдено ранее окно обучения, в котором readout перестраивается и категории WordNet становятся декодируемыми из его строк, при этом линейные пробы уже декодируют задачу. Эксперименты с малыми моделями, различающимися только learning rate readout, показывают, что более быстрое обучение readout сокращает разрыв, почти не влияя на итоговый loss.

en.title: Unlocking Hidden States: Understanding Readout Learning in Language Models
en.desc: This paper explores how hidden states in language models can contain task information before the model's readout layer expresses it. It highlights that traditional methods of tracking model capabilities often confuse the learning of the model with the learning of the readout. The authors introduce a technique called parameter-trajectory crosscoding to directly analyze the readout's learning process. Their findings suggest that adjusting the learning rate of the readout can accelerate its development, indicating that behavioral timelines may reflect readout learning rather than the model's actual acquisition of capabilities.

zh.title: 输出学习速率影响模型能力获取的时间
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了语言模型在学习能力时的隐藏状态与输出之间的关系。研究表明，模型的隐藏状态可以在输出表达之前编码任务信息，因此输出的时间线反映的是输出学习而非模型获取。通过引入参数轨迹交叉编码的方法，研究者能够直接追踪输出的学习过程。结果显示，提升输出学习速率可以使得模型更早地表达任务信息，从而缩短隐藏状态与输出之间的差距。

papers.title: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
papers.abstract: Abstract Selection bias and order sensitivity in multiple-choice models are decomposed into flip rate and positional skew via pooled standard deviation, showing that prior correction and aggregation target different factors and should be reported together with accuracy.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Reordering multiple-choice options can change a model's answer, an effect studied as selection bias (a preference for certain option letters) and as order sensitivity (changes in answers across option orderings). We connect these perspectives through the pooled selection-rate standard deviation (pooled SD), which measures how unevenly option letters are selected across questions and orderings. When every option of each question appears equally often at each position, the pooled SD is exactly the product of two label-free factors: the flip rate and the positional skew. The flip rate is the fraction of questions whose chosen option changes across orderings; the positional skew is the standard deviation of option-letter selection rates among those questions. Across 41 checkpoints and 12 benchmarks, the flip rate tracks accuracy and output uncertainty, while the positional skew tracks the estimated option-symbol prior. Prior correction for selection bias mainly reduces the positional skew. Aggregating each ordering with its reversal, a mitigation for order sensitivity, mainly reduces the flip rate. Both reduce the range of accuracy across correct-answer letters by similar amounts, but aggregation leaves fewer model-rank reversals. Applying prior correction before aggregation reduces both factors and further narrows this accuracy range. However, aggregation lowers the flip rate partly by settling questions on the same wrong option. We therefore recommend reporting both factors to distinguish mitigation effects, alongside accuracy to distinguish stability from correctness.
affiliations: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)

ru.title: Порядок вариантов меняет ответ: раскладываем смещение на два фактора и измеряем их вместе с точностью
ru.desc: В статье рассматривается, как порядок вариантов ответа в тестах с выбором (multiple-choice) влияет на предсказания LLM, и это явление разделяется на selection bias (предпочтение определённых букв) и order sensitivity (изменение ответа при перестановке вариантов). Авторы вводят pooled SD и показывают, что она точно раскладывается на произведение двух факторов: flip rate (доля вопросов, где ответ меняется) и positional skew (разброс частот выбора букв). Эксперименты на 41 чекпоинте и 12 бенчмарках показывают, что prior correction снижает в основном positional skew, а агрегация ответов по прямому и обратному порядку снижает в основном flip rate. Вывод: эти два фактора нужно сообщать вместе с точностью, чтобы отличать реальную стабильность от правильности ответов.

en.title: Understanding Selection Bias and Order Sensitivity in Multiple-Choice Models
en.desc: This paper investigates how the order of multiple-choice options can influence the answers given by machine learning models, focusing on two main issues: selection bias and order sensitivity. It introduces the concept of pooled standard deviation to quantify these effects, breaking them down into flip rate (how often answers change with different orderings) and positional skew (how unevenly options are chosen). The study finds that correcting for selection bias primarily affects positional skew, while aggregating answers from different orderings mainly impacts the flip rate. The authors suggest that both metrics should be reported alongside accuracy to provide a clearer understanding of a model's performance and stability.

zh.title: 选择偏差与顺序敏感性的双重分析
zh.desc: 本文探讨了多选模型中的选择偏差和顺序敏感性，提出了翻转率和位置偏斜的概念。通过计算合并标准差，研究了选项字母在不同问题和顺序中的选择不均匀性。翻转率表示在不同顺序中选择的选项变化的比例，而位置偏斜则是选项选择率的标准差。研究结果表明，选择偏差的校正和顺序敏感性的聚合应同时报告，以便更好地理解模型的准确性和稳定性。

papers.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
papers.abstract: Abstract Remote KV caching for long-context LLM serving can severely degrade latency unless the store is sharded by parallel rank, loaded asynchronously, and paired with high-bandwidth retrieval, yielding large throughput gains.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. A two-term cost model explains both: a hit pays off only if the tier delivers more than B* = sR (2.53 GB/s for this model and GPU), and a fixed per-hit engine cost (T0 ~ 0.33 s) means that hits on prompts shorter than about 17k tokens cannot beat recompute at any bandwidth. Guided by the model, we (i) shard the MLA KV store across PCP ranks, with a proof that the existing minimum-over-ranks lookup returns the longest cached prefix and a load protocol that can never desynchronize collectives; (ii) partition the remote tier by rank, one server instance per rank with no coordination, which raises GET bandwidth 6.3x to 10.76 GB/s; (iii) add asynchronous loading to the sharded store; and (iv) fix three client bugs that caused unbounded stalls. On the hit-heavy stream, with 98.5% of prompt tokens served from the remote tier, p99 falls from 83.32 s to 0.67 s. The sharded store raises prefill throughput by 14%, and by 34% together with an upstream kernel fix. All changes are submitted upstream to LMCache.

ru.title: Умный шардинг KV-кэша превращает медленный удалённый кэш в быстрый
ru.desc: Статья исследует удалённый KV-кэш для LLM с длинным контекстом в режиме disaggregated serving, где сетевой обмен может сильно замедлять ответ, а не ускорять его. Авторы выводят простую модель затрат: попадание в кэш окупается только при достаточной пропускной способности, а фиксированные накладные расходы делают короткие промпты невыгодными для загрузки. На основе модели они шардируют MLA-кэш по рангам PCP, разделяют удалённое хранилище по рангам, добавляют асинхронную загрузку и исправляют ошибки клиента. В итоге p99 TTFT на потоке с попаданиями падает с 83 с до 0.67 с, а пропускная способность prefill растёт на 14–34%.

en.title: Boosting LLM Performance with Smart KV Caching
en.desc: This paper discusses improvements in remote key-value (KV) caching for long-context large language model (LLM) serving, focusing on reducing latency. The authors demonstrate that sharding the KV store by parallel rank and implementing asynchronous loading can significantly enhance throughput. They analyze the performance of a disaggregated deployment of the GLM-5.3 model and find that optimizing the remote tier can drastically lower the time to process requests. The proposed solutions lead to a remarkable reduction in latency for hit-heavy streams, showcasing the effectiveness of their approach in real-world applications.

zh.title: 优化远程KV缓存，提升LLM服务性能
zh.desc: 本文研究了远程键值缓存（KV缓存）在长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务中的应用，指出其在未进行分片和异步加载时会导致延迟增加。通过对GLM-5.3模型的实验，发现启用远程缓存后，尽管首次响应时间保持不变，但在高负载情况下延迟显著增加。为了解决这一问题，作者提出了对KV存储进行分片、按等级划分远程缓存，并引入异步加载等优化措施。最终，这些改进使得在高负载请求流中，延迟从83.32秒降至0.67秒，显著提升了系统的吞吐量和响应速度。

papers.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Abstract A framework dynamically assigns denoising steps to video patches based on difficulty, cutting computation by half while preserving quality.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. This ignores the spatial heterogeneity of video content: static, simple, or recurring regions are often easier to denoise, while other regions require further refinement or additional context. A uniform budget thus leads to redundant computation on easy patches, whereas reducing the fixed step count can leave difficult patches insufficiently refined. We introduce , a general framework that dynamically allocates denoising steps to individual patches: easy patches stop early to improve efficiency, while difficult patches receive more refinement steps. This design accelerates generation with negligible quality degradation. Our method is compatible with most existing few-step autoregressive diffusion models, requiring only a lightweight routing module with modest training. Experiments demonstrate that  reduces the total number of denoising steps applied across video patches by about 50\% while maintaining visual quality comparable to the four-step baseline.
affiliations: Macau University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Больше вычислений для сложных патчей, меньше для простых
ru.desc: В статье предлагается фреймворк, который динамически распределяет шаги denoising между отдельными патчами видео в autoregressive diffusion models. Простые и статичные области завершают генерацию раньше, а сложные патчи получают больше шагов уточнения. Для этого используется легковесный routing module, который обучается отдельно и совместим с большинством few-step моделей. Эксперименты показывают, что общее число шагов уменьшается примерно на 50% при визуальном качестве, сопоставимом с базовой четырехшаговой моделью.

en.title: Dynamic Denoising for Efficient Video Generation
en.desc: This paper presents a new framework that optimizes the denoising process in video generation by dynamically assigning different numbers of denoising steps to various video patches based on their complexity. Instead of applying the same denoising schedule to all patches, the framework allows easier patches to finish early, thus saving computational resources. More challenging patches receive additional refinement steps to ensure high-quality output. The approach significantly reduces computation time by approximately 50% while maintaining visual quality similar to traditional methods.

zh.title: 动态去噪步骤分配，提高视频生成效率
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种动态分配去噪步骤的框架，针对视频中的不同区域根据难度进行调整，从而将计算量减少一半，同时保持生成质量。现有方法通常对所有视频块均匀分配计算资源，忽视了视频内容的空间异质性。通过让简单区域提前停止去噪，复杂区域则获得更多的去噪步骤，我们的方法提高了生成效率，且质量损失微乎其微。实验结果表明，该框架在保持视觉质量的同时，减少了视频块的去噪步骤总数约50%。

papers.title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
papers.abstract: Abstract CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that uses a video world model as a flexible visual reasoning engine, enabling vision-language models to perform diverse spatiotemporal reasoning through guided visual imagination and co-evolving tools.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution, which jointly revises tools, skills, and execution code based on execution feedback while keeping both model weights fixed. Across seven benchmarks spanning spatial intelligence, temporal and causal reasoning, and perceptual reasoning, CoWorld Reasoner outperforms direct reasoning with the same VLM. The strongest variant improves on all seven benchmarks, including relative accuracy gains of 11.8% on MMSI and 13.0% on ERQA, and outperforms all five evolving baselines using the same backbone across five benchmarks.

ru.title: Думать глазами мира: видео-модель как движок визуального воображения для VLM
ru.desc: В статье представлен CoWorld Reasoner — агентный фреймворк, который использует видео-мировую модель (Video World Model) как гибкий движок визуального рассуждения для Vision-Language Model (VLM). Система через набор инструментов и навыков решает, нужно ли «воображать» визуальные сцены, выбирает операцию и формирует запрос на генерацию, после чего интерпретирует полученные визуальные данные. Метод VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution совместно улучшает инструменты, навыки и исполняемый код по обратной связи, не меняя веса моделей. На семи бенчмарках CoWorld Reasoner превосходит прямое рассуждение той же VLM, например дает прирост точности 11.8% на MMSI и 13.0% на ERQA.

en.title: Empowering Visual Reasoning with Dynamic Imagination
en.desc: The CoWorld Reasoner is a new framework that enhances vision-language models (VLMs) by integrating a video world model (VWM) for improved visual reasoning. It allows these models to perform complex reasoning tasks involving motion and changes in perspective by generating relevant visual content dynamically. Unlike traditional methods that rely on fixed visual imagination processes, CoWorld Reasoner offers a flexible approach that adapts to various reasoning challenges. By co-evolving tools and skills based on feedback, it significantly improves performance across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness in spatial, temporal, and causal reasoning tasks.

zh.title: 灵活的视觉推理新框架
zh.desc: CoWorld Reasoner 是一个智能框架，利用视频世界模型作为灵活的视觉推理引擎，使得视觉语言模型能够通过引导的视觉想象和共同演化的工具进行多样的时空推理。视频世界模型提供了一种自然的统一引擎，通过生成与任务相关的视觉内容作为额外证据，支持视觉想象。该框架通过工具暴露多种视觉操作，并使用技能指导视觉语言模型决定是否进行想象、选择操作、构建生成请求和解释结果视觉证据。实验结果表明，CoWorld Reasoner 在七个基准测试中表现优于直接推理，尤其在空间智能、时间因果推理和感知推理方面取得了显著的准确率提升。

papers.title: PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Abstract PINT unifies vision-language reasoning, video world modeling, and action generation via learnable predictive intent tokens to improve robot manipulation generalization without embodied pretraining.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Generalist robot manipulation can benefit from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for semantic reasoning and video generation models (VGMs) for world modeling. However, existing unified models that directly fuse them through shared attention at multiple layers can make it harder to draw on their specialized capabilities. We introduce PINT, a unified model that coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared chunk-level Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. PINT inserts learnable Intent Tokens into the VLM sequence to form this representation, conditioning both the VGM and an Action Expert (AE). It replaces only the VGM's prompt conditioning and retains the VGM at inference, where the AE reads its representations through one-way attention. Rather than prescribing what Predictive Intent should encode, PINT learns it jointly from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE, which provide complementary views of the same upcoming task execution. Training uses two stages: Stage 1 freezes the VGM so that future video prediction shapes Predictive Intent with task-relevant future dynamics, while Stage 2 fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM and AE. Without embodied pretraining, PINT achieves strong in-distribution (ID) performance and substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, reaching 15.5% on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard compared with 1.8% for Fast-WAM and 3.2% for StarVLA, and 79.5% on LIBERO-Plus compared with 51.5% and 75.0%, respectively. Across five real-world bimanual tasks, PINT reaches 68% ID and 24% OOD success, compared with 35%/9% for pretrained Motus and 67%/35% for pretrained π_{0.5}.

University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Единое намерение робота: видеть, предсказывать и действовать
ru.desc: В статье представлена модель PINT, которая объединяет семантические рассуждения vision-language model (VLM), прогнозирование видео через video generation model (VGM) и генерацию действий Action Expert (AE) для управления роботом. Ключевая идея заключается в обучаемых Intent Tokens, которые формируют общее представление Predictive Intent, сохраняя при этом специализированные пути каждого эксперта. Обучение проходит в два этапа: сначала VGM заморожен, чтобы Predictive Intent учился на будущей динамике задачи, затем Intent фиксируется и дообучаются VGM и AE. Без предварительного обучения на данных роботов модель заметно улучшает обобщение на out-of-distribution сценарии, показывая более высокие результаты на RoboTwin 2.0-Hard и LIBERO-Plus.

en.title: PINT: Unifying Vision, Video, and Action for Smarter Robot Manipulation
en.desc: The paper introduces PINT, a novel model that integrates vision-language reasoning, video world modeling, and action generation to enhance robot manipulation capabilities without requiring prior embodied pretraining. PINT utilizes learnable Predictive Intent Tokens to coordinate these tasks while maintaining the specialized functions of existing models. By employing a two-stage training process, it effectively learns to predict task execution dynamics and adapts its components for improved performance. The results demonstrate significant advancements in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution generalization for robotic tasks compared to existing methods.

zh.title: PINT：提升机器人操作的统一模型
zh.desc: PINT是一种统一模型，通过可学习的预测意图令牌来协调语义推理、世界建模和动作生成，从而提高机器人操作的泛化能力，而无需进行实体预训练。该模型利用预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）和视频生成模型（VGM），在多个层次上共享注意力来融合它们的能力。PINT通过在VLM序列中插入可学习的意图令牌，形成一种表示，条件化VGM和动作专家（AE）。在没有实体预训练的情况下，PINT在分布内和分布外的表现均显著提升，展示了其在复杂任务中的有效性。

papers.title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Abstract VascuSR is an iterative diffusion framework that integrates 3D vascular guidance with super-resolution to improve anatomical accuracy and vascular connectivity in CT reconstructions.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller injects the refined structure into the diffusion decoder, while iterative feedback updates this guidance from each new SR volume. On re-annotated MSD Task08 and HVM datasets, VascuSR outperforms interpolation and learning-based SR baselines in segmentation accuracy (Dice and clDice) and 3D vascular structure (connectivity and mean centerline distance), while maintaining image quality comparable to its SR backbone. Compared with learning-based baselines, VascuSR reduces class-averaged connected-component counts by over 20% on both datasets and mean centerline distance by over 10% on MSD.

ru.title: Точные сосуды на КТ: анатомия направляет диффузию
ru.desc: Статья представляет VascuSR — итеративную диффузионную модель для super-resolution КТ-снимков, которая использует явное 3D-представление сосудов для улучшения анатомической точности. Легковесный 3D generative refiner уточняет сосудистую структуру, а anatomy controller передаёт её в diffusion decoder при обработке срезов. Итеративная обратная связь обновляет руководство на основе каждого нового SR-объёма, что повышает связность сосудов. На датасетах MSD Task08 и HVM метод превосходит интерполяцию и learning-based baselines по Dice, clDice и числу компонент связности, сохраняя качество изображения на уровне backbone.

en.title: Enhancing CT Imaging with Vascular-Aware Super-Resolution
en.desc: VascuSR is a novel iterative diffusion framework designed to enhance the accuracy of 3D vascular structures in computed tomography (CT) images. It combines super-resolution techniques with a 3D vascular representation to ensure that the reconstructed images maintain anatomical correctness while recovering fine details. By integrating an anatomy-aware controller, VascuSR refines vascular structures and improves connectivity in the generated images. The framework demonstrates superior performance in segmentation accuracy and vascular structure metrics compared to traditional interpolation and learning-based super-resolution methods.

zh.title: VascuSR：提升CT重建的血管精度与连通性
zh.desc: VascuSR是一种迭代扩散框架，结合了三维血管引导和超分辨率技术，以提高CT重建的解剖准确性和血管连通性。该方法通过显式的三维血管表示，提供更丰富的解剖指导，从而改善图像重建过程。VascuSR使用轻量级的解剖控制器，将优化后的血管结构注入扩散解码器，并通过迭代反馈不断更新指导信息。实验结果表明，VascuSR在分割准确性和三维血管结构方面优于传统的插值和学习基础的超分辨率方法。

papers.title: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
papers.abstract: Abstract EVA-Cap improves audiovisual video captioning by decomposing captions into atomic events and optimizing event-centric alignment through supervised fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap significantly outperforms existing methods in event-centric evaluation (e.g., +9.0% average gain on ChronusAV), while achieving competitive performance on general audiovisual captioning benchmarks (e.g., +3.3% on WorldSense).

ru.title: Описываем видео через атомарные события, а не просто текст
ru.desc: Статья представляет EVA-Cap — фреймворк для аудиовизуального описания видео (audiovisual video captioning) на базе Omni Language Models (OLM). Вместо неструктурированной генерации текста модель разбивает описание на атомарные аудиовизуальные события и выравнивает их по событиям. Обучение проходит в два этапа: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) и Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) на собственном датасете EVA-Data с контролем качества по событиям. Эксперименты показывают существенный прирост на event-centric бенчмарках, например +9.0% на ChronusAV, при конкурентных результатах на общих бенчмарках вроде WorldSense.

en.title: EVA-Cap: Enhancing Video Captioning through Event-Centric Alignment
en.desc: EVA-Cap is a new framework designed to enhance audiovisual video captioning by breaking down captions into smaller, meaningful events. It focuses on aligning these events more accurately through a process called supervised fine-tuning and a technique known as group relative policy optimization. This approach addresses the limitations of previous methods that treated captioning as simple text generation, which often missed the detailed structure of the video content. The results show that EVA-Cap performs significantly better in evaluating event-specific alignment while still maintaining strong overall performance in general captioning tasks.

zh.title: EVA-Cap：优化视听字幕生成的事件中心对齐
zh.desc: EVA-Cap 是一种改进视听视频字幕生成的方法，它将字幕分解为基本事件，并通过监督微调和组相对策略优化来优化事件中心的对齐。该方法利用了最新的全语言模型，提供了一种统一的解决方案，但传统方法往往忽视了视频的语义结构。EVA-Cap 通过将无结构的文本监督转化为事件中心的对齐，解决了这一问题。实验结果表明，EVA-Cap 在事件中心评估中显著优于现有方法，同时在一般视听字幕基准上也表现出竞争力。

papers.title: ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs
papers.abstract: Abstract ANTE is a reinforcement learning framework that uses pre-action predictions verified by execution to provide per-step credit and improve coding agent decisions, significantly boosting benchmark performance.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

ru.title: Сначала предскажи, потом выполни: агент, который заглядывает вперёд
ru.desc: Статья представляет ANTE — фреймворк обучения с подкреплением (RL) для LLM-агентов, которые пишут код. Перед каждым действием агент делает прогноз о его результате, а реальное выполнение в контейнере проверяет эти предсказания. Метод BAPO использует проверенные прогнозы как per-step advantage, давая точную оценку каждому шагу вместо одной терминальной награды. На SWE-bench Verified Qwen3-32B повышает pass@1 с 25.0% до 57.2%, превосходя GRPO-базлайн без belief state на 6.2%.

en.title: Anticipate Actions for Smarter Coding Agents
en.desc: ANTE is a reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance coding agents by incorporating pre-action predictions that are validated through execution. This approach allows the agent to assign credit for its actions based on the outcomes of previous steps, improving decision-making and overall performance. By utilizing Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO), ANTE effectively transforms predictions into actionable insights, enabling the agent to anticipate the consequences of its actions. The framework demonstrates significant improvements in coding task performance, showcasing its ability to adapt and learn from both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios.

zh.title: 预见行动，优化决策
zh.desc: ANTE是一个强化学习框架，通过执行验证预先的动作预测，为每一步提供信用，从而改善编码代理的决策，显著提升基准性能。该框架允许编码代理在容器化环境中，根据工具响应或执行结果来决定后续动作。与现有编码代理不同，ANTE能够预见动作的后果，并将失败归因于早期步骤，从而避免不当编辑导致的不可逆转的仓库状态损坏。通过Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization（BAPO），ANTE将预测转化为每一步的优势，提升了模型在测试时的表现。

papers.title: Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility
papers.abstract: Abstract Sparse autoencoders can be trained with far fewer activation tokens when data budgets align with evaluation goals, though feature-level reproducibility demands larger scales.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are typically trained on hundreds of millions to billions of activation tokens, yet little work has tested whether this scale is necessary. We study how much activation data SAEs need by training four SAE architectures on three language models with budgets ranging from 5M tokens to a 500M-token reference. We measure two notions of convergence: functional behavior on standard evaluations and one-to-one reproducibility of learned features. Functional data requirements are strongly metric-dependent: reconstruction often approaches the full-data reference at substantially smaller budgets, whereas feature reproducibility continues to improve with data. For Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK, the fraction of strictly matched features rises from 2\% at 5M tokens to 29\% at 50M. Data selection also matters: random sampling better preserves the original activation distribution and generally favors reconstruction, whereas diversity-based sampling frequently improves AutoInterp. A theoretical analysis separates statistical consistency of subsampled training from the stronger identifiability and optimization conditions required for one-to-one feature recovery. Our results show that SAE training can often be made far more data-efficient when budgets are matched to the goal, and feature-level claims are backed by explicit reproducibility checks, paving the way toward cheaper and more reliable SAE research.

ru.title: Данных для SAE нужно меньше, чем кажется, но признаки требуют проверки
ru.desc: Авторы исследуют, сколько данных о активациях нужно для обучения разреженных автоэнкодеров (SAE) в больших языковых моделях (LLM). Они сравнивают четыре архитектуры SAE на трёх моделях при бюджетах от 5M до 500M токенов. Оказалось, что для качества реконструкции часто достаточно гораздо меньше данных, тогда как воспроизводимость отдельных признаков растёт с объёмом данных. Теоретический анализ показывает, что статистическая состоятельность и однозначная идентифицируемость признаков — разные условия, поэтому для таких утверждений нужны явные проверки воспроизводимости.

en.title: Optimizing Sparse Autoencoder Training with Smart Data Budgets
en.desc: This paper investigates the data requirements for training Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) by analyzing how different amounts of activation tokens affect their performance. The authors find that while functional performance can be achieved with fewer tokens, feature-level reproducibility requires larger datasets. They demonstrate that the effectiveness of data sampling methods influences the training outcomes, with random sampling generally favoring reconstruction tasks. Overall, the study suggests that aligning data budgets with specific evaluation goals can lead to more efficient and reliable SAE training.

zh.title: 优化稀疏自编码器的训练数据效率
zh.desc: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）可以在数据预算与评估目标一致时，用更少的激活标记进行训练。我们研究了SAE所需的激活数据量，发现功能性行为在较小的数据预算下也能接近全数据参考，而特征的可重复性则需要更多的数据。数据选择对结果也有影响，随机抽样更好地保留了原始激活分布，而基于多样性的抽样则常常改善了AutoInterp。我们的研究表明，当预算与目标匹配时，SAE训练可以更高效，特征级的声明也可以通过明确的可重复性检查得到支持。

papers.title: Speech event detector: Timestamped detection of non-verbal vocalizations and background sounds for rich speech transcription
papers.abstract: Abstract A convolutional-Transformer model detects 54 speech and background event classes with timestamped outputs merged into transcripts, trained on unified multi-source annotations with synthetic augmentation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Automatic speech recognition produces words but drops the non-verbal content of a recording: the breaths, coughs, sighs and laughter of the speaker, and the horns, music or barking around them. We describe Speech Event Detector, a 5.8-million-parameter convolutional-Transformer model that outputs probabilities every 40 ms for 54 event classes (20 speaker vocalizations and 34 background sounds), together with post-processing that converts these probabilities into timestamped events and a procedure for merging the events into a Whisper transcript. The model is trained on material drawn from seven public datasets whose labels come in incompatible forms: single detected regions, free-text tags with timestamps, temporally strong ontology labels, symbols embedded in transcripts, isolated recordings and environmental recordings. We unify them using rule-based label mapping, recover timestamps for transcript-embedded labels through CTC forced alignment, locating 6,360 of 8,620 sounds, and combine about 168 hours of real annotated training recordings with synthetic mixtures and augmentation using real background noise. Per-class thresholds for two operating profiles are tuned on real held-out recordings, and performance is estimated using two-fold cross-validation. On whole held-out recordings from four datasets, considering the 48 classes with at least ten held-out events, the sensitive profile detects an average of 49 percent of a class's events, covering 67 percent of all 9,367 events, at a macro precision of 0.30. The balanced profile achieves a macro recall of 0.37 at a precision of 0.36, with macro event F1 scores of 0.32 and 0.33, respectively. The detector runs about 39 times faster than real time on eight CPU threads.

ru.title: Слышим не только слова, но и всё, что происходит вокруг
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Speech Event Detector — компактную свёрточно-Transformer модель на 5,8 млн параметров, которая каждые 40 мс предсказывает вероятности 54 классов речевых и фоновых событий, таких как вдохи, кашель, смех, гудки и лай. Разнородные размеченные датасеты приведены к единому формату с помощью правил и CTC forced alignment, а обучение дополнено синтетическими смесями и аугментацией реальным фоновым шумом. Пороги для каждого класса подобраны на реальных данных, а результаты оценены кросс-валидацией, при этом модель работает примерно в 39 раз быстрее реального времени на CPU. Выходные события с временными метками объединяются с транскриптом Whisper, что делает распознавание речи более полным.

en.title: Detecting Speech Events with Speed and Precision
en.desc: This paper presents a convolutional-Transformer model called Speech Event Detector, which identifies 54 different speech and background events with precise timestamps. The model is trained on a diverse set of annotations from multiple datasets, using synthetic data augmentation to enhance its performance. It outputs probabilities for each event every 40 milliseconds and employs post-processing to convert these into timestamped events that can be integrated into transcripts. The model demonstrates efficient performance, achieving significant detection rates while operating much faster than real-time processing.

zh.title: 高效语音事件检测的卷积-变换器模型
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种卷积-变换器模型，能够检测54种语音和背景事件类别，并将时间戳输出合并到转录文本中。该模型通过统一多源注释和合成增强进行训练，能够每40毫秒输出54个事件类别的概率。我们使用基于规则的标签映射来统一不同格式的标签，并通过CTC强制对齐恢复嵌入转录文本的时间戳。最终，该检测器在八个CPU线程上运行速度约为实时的39倍，展示了其高效性和准确性。

papers.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract SimForcing improves action-conditioned robot world models by distilling motion knowledge from simulation and using controllable simulation conditioning to generate realistic videos across robot datasets.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing

ru.title: Симуляция учит робота предсказывать движение реального мира
ru.desc: Статья представляет SimForcing — фреймворк для action-conditioned world models роботов, который использует симуляцию как источник переносимых знаний о движении и как управляемую опору для предсказаний. Метод через latent-motion distillation переносит временные изменения из симуляционного учителя в латентное пространство, снижая влияние различий во внешнем виде. Multi-block simulation conditioning с condition dropout и classifier-free guidance балансирует предсказания на основе внутренних motion priors и симуляционных латентов, не полагаясь чрезмерно на точность симуляции. Модель показывает лучшие PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS и FVD на Bridge и хорошо переносится на другие датасеты и на инициализацию VLA-модели с улучшением успешности на LIBERO.

en.title: Enhancing Robot World Models with Simulation Knowledge
en.desc: SimForcing is a framework designed to enhance robot world models by leveraging knowledge from simulations to improve video generation. It addresses the challenge of aligning robot trajectories with realistic visual dynamics by distilling motion knowledge from a simulation teacher. The framework employs a method called latent-motion distillation to align motion changes while minimizing the impact of visual differences. Additionally, it uses a simulation-conditioning approach that balances predictions from internalized motion knowledge with those guided by simulation, resulting in high-quality video generation across various robot datasets.

zh.title: SimForcing：提升机器人世界模型的模拟知识提取
zh.desc: SimForcing是一种改进机器人世界模型的方法，通过从模拟中提取运动知识，并利用可控的模拟条件生成逼真的视频。该方法解决了在异构机器人视频中学习时，机器人轨迹与视觉动态之间的精确响应问题。SimForcing通过潜在运动蒸馏将模拟教师的运动知识转移，并引入多块模拟条件以优化预测。最终，经过联合训练的模型能够生成模拟条件和真实视频，无需额外的世界模型。

papers.title: AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract An AI-driven framework uses learned ranking and deterministic EDA analysis to recover post-route power while controlling repair costs and preserving timing, electrical, and physical constraints.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Post-route power recovery changes cell choices under tightly coupled timing, electrical and physical constraints, and the value of each change depends on what it costs to repair its side effects. We propose an AI-driven framework in which a learned model drives both phases of the optimization: it ranks the powerrecovery edits to try and the repair actions that follow, while deterministic electronic design automation (EDA) analyses govern every acceptance. The framework records baseline constraint margins, identifies the damage a recovery transaction introduces in each analysis view, holds pre-existing violations at their baseline rather than working them inside the power step, and caps repair spending at a fraction of the measured saving. An ensemble of gradient-boosted models predicts power change, normalized damage reduction and constraint-regression risk from action and timing-context features available before each trial; calibrated, conservative estimates feed separate acquisition scores for recovery and repair, with a deterministic fallback when the model is uncertain. Recovery and repair remain speculative until physical implementation and fresh analysis establish baseline preservation and positive net saving. We specify the contract, the learned policy, the transactional flow and a pre-registered public evaluation protocol on open designs. Evidence from a companion study on public designs supports the contract; the learned policy is proposed, and no trained-model results or proprietary design measurements are reported.

ru.title: Меньше энергии в чипе: умный выбор правок, проверенный строгими анализами
ru.desc: В статье предлагается фреймворк на базе AI, который снижает потребляемую мощность после трассировки микросхемы, выбирая замены ячеек. Обученная модель (ансамбль градиентных бустингов) предсказывает выигрыш по мощности, снижение повреждений и риск нарушения ограничений, а затем ранжирует правки и действия по исправлению. Все принятые изменения проверяются детерминированными EDA-анализами, при этом существующие нарушения фиксируются на исходном уровне, а затраты на ремонт ограничиваются долей от измеренной экономии. Работа описывает контракт, политику обучения и протокол открытой оценки, однако результаты обученной модели в ней пока не приводятся.

en.title: AI-Powered Optimization for Efficient Power Recovery in Electronic Designs
en.desc: This paper presents an AI-driven framework designed to optimize power recovery in electronic designs while adhering to strict timing, electrical, and physical constraints. The framework utilizes a learned ranking model to prioritize power recovery edits and subsequent repair actions, ensuring that any changes made do not exceed a predetermined repair budget. By employing deterministic electronic design automation (EDA) analyses, the framework evaluates the impact of each action on the design's constraints and maintains baseline margins. The approach is validated through a public evaluation protocol, demonstrating its effectiveness in balancing power recovery with cost and constraint preservation.

zh.title: 智能优化：功耗恢复与修复成本的平衡
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种基于人工智能的框架，用于在后路由阶段恢复功耗，同时控制修复成本，并保持时序、电气和物理约束。该框架利用学习到的模型来驱动优化的两个阶段：首先对功耗恢复的编辑进行排名，然后进行相应的修复操作。通过确定性电子设计自动化（EDA）分析来管理每个接受的决策，确保在修复过程中不会超过预设的成本限制。研究还提供了一个公开评估协议，以验证所提出的学习策略和合同的有效性。

papers.title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract PAIR introduces a shared perception-action representation via masked action autoencoders and bridge tokens to improve continuous-action vision-language-action models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

ru.title: Общий мост между восприятием и действием делает роботов увереннее
ru.desc: В статье представлен фреймворк PAIR, который учит общее промежуточное представление между восприятием и действием для vision-language-action (VLA) моделей с непрерывными действиями. Во время обучения Masked Action Autoencoder кодирует экспертные action chunks в Action Latent Tokens, а Bridge Module извлекает признаки из visual-language представлений и выравнивает их с этими токенами, формируя Bridge Tokens. Эти токены инъецируются в начальные Action Tokens, давая Action Expert более удачную стартовую точку для уточнения действий, а на инференсе автоэнкодер не используется. Эксперименты на LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN и в реальных роботизированных задачах показывают прирост успешности для моделей OpenVLA-OFT и VLA-Adapter.

en.title: Bridging Perception and Action for Better Robot Control
en.desc: The paper introduces PAIR, a framework designed to enhance continuous-action vision-language-action (VLA) models by creating a shared perception-action representation. It utilizes Masked Action Autoencoders to encode expert actions into Action Latent Tokens, which are aligned with task-relevant features extracted by a Bridge Module. This alignment forms Bridge Tokens that encapsulate essential task information and facilitate the transition from perception to action generation. Experimental results demonstrate that PAIR significantly improves the performance of VLA models across various tasks, indicating the effectiveness of a shared intermediate representation in bridging perception and action.

zh.title: 共享感知-动作表示的创新
zh.desc: PAIR框架通过掩码动作自编码器和桥接令牌，引入了一种共享的感知-动作表示，以改善连续动作的视觉-语言-动作模型。该框架将视觉观察和语言指令映射到连续的机器人动作，解决了从描述场景和指令的表示到支持动作生成的表示的过渡问题。通过训练，掩码动作自编码器将专家动作块编码为与时间对齐的动作潜在令牌，而桥接模块提取当前视觉-语言表示中的任务相关特征。实验结果表明，PAIR显著提高了多个模型在真实世界任务中的成功率，证明了共享中间表示在连续动作视觉-语言-动作模型中的有效性。
